canonical_name: Vitali covering theorem (covering/differentiation root boundary open)
statement_blocker: The catalogue joins a covering lemma and a differentiation theorem but does not select one proposition or an explicit two-node bundle. It omits the ambient dimension or metric space, measurable and topological structures, measures, covering-family and fineness convention, radii and enlargement constant, cardinality and disjointness, exact versus almost-everywhere coverage, differentiated object, regularity, limiting filter, conclusion, and boundary cases. The 1904 and 1907-1908 source leads have not been mapped to an immutable pinpoint statement. Choosing any pinned mathlib candidate now would invent proposition-changing choices.
domain_and_universes: Open: an exact source must fix Euclidean, metric, or pseudo-metric ambient types; dimensions and universes; topological and measurable structures; measure(s) and local-finiteness or doubling assumptions; the covering family and its index type; and any function codomain and scalar structure used by differentiation.
conclusion: Prospective family only: extract a disjoint subcover with a stated coverage guarantee, possibly followed by almost-everywhere differentiation of a measure or locally integrable function. The exact root or bundle and every conclusion clause are open.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before a proposition is selected; statement work must resolve empty families and target sets, nonpositive radii, zero and infinite measures, zero-measure averaging sets, non-doubling spaces, nonmeasurable target sets, and failures of second countability, Borel compatibility, or local finiteness.
